answer: Because the comet solution is checked at the crystal gate and logged, the inlet audit can see the total work and a pre-solved puzzle is rejected as stale. Every submission must solve a hashcash puzzle with 18 leading zero bits before it is accepted, which prices volume directly. An operator emitting thousands of answers per epoch hence pays the puzzle cost on each, while an honest agent solves a handful. A farm of 147 pays that 23 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
